seoFaq.intro: Wondering how long <1>shipping from China to Canada</1> takes or how much it costs? Below are the most common questions, covering air, sea and express channels.

time.title: How long does shipping take?
time.body:
<1>Air freight: 5–10 business days.
<1>Sea freight LCL: 20–35 days.
<1>Sea freight FCL: 25–40 days.
Express (DHL/FedEx): 3–7 days at premium cost.

cost.title: How much does it cost to ship to Canada?
cost.body:
Air freight: <1>$6–15 CAD/kg.
Sea freight LCL: <1>$3–8 CAD/kg equivalent.
Chinese-Canadian forwarders are 30–60% cheaper than DHL/FedEx for parcels over 5 kg.

us.title: Shipping from the US to Canada?
us.body: For US ↔ Canada, USPS + Canada Post works for small parcels, or use a US forwarding address when retailers don't ship cross-border. For <1>China ↔ Canada</1>, compare freight forwarders here on SaveShipCost.
